nodes.name: Repository-local knowledge graph
nodes.summary: kgmaker is a custom, repository-local knowledge graph tool designed specifically for GitHub Copilot CLI.

nodes.name: Source code is authoritative
nodes.summary: When documentation conflicts with code-derived facts, source code wins and contradictions remain report evidence.

nodes.name: Explicit workspace service ownership
nodes.summary: Workspace service ownership is assigned only by explicit repository roots or exact repo-qualified module IDs; ambiguity remains visible.

nodes.name: Optional agent-authored semantic layer
nodes.summary: The extraction workflow keeps agent-authored semantic relationships scoped and separate from deterministic graph extraction.

nodes.name: Explicit service inventory projection
nodes.summary: The T008 topology view composes explicit ownership with provider contexts; scoped SOURCE_ONLY roots remain PARTIAL with module coverage UNKNOWN.

edges.evidence: Architecture identifies scanner.py as the layer that walks the repository and extracts files, declarations, imports, and conservative call candidates.
Architecture identifies store.py as the layer that writes the machine graph and generated views.
Architecture states that source code is authoritative and contradictions are retained as evidence.
Architecture explicitly identifies workspace.resolve_service_ownership as the function that returns ownership status from declared roots and module IDs.
The README describes the local stable-ID inventory used for optional agent-authored semantic extraction.
apply_semantic_patch applies a scoped agent patch while preserving semantic facts outside the change impact.
validate_semantic_data validates IDs, provenance, confidence, and graph freshness before merging semantic entries.
The README describes the bounded semantic update packet and scoped application of its patch.
Architecture identifies views.project_service_inventory as the topology projection that composes explicit ownership and selected provider contexts.
